title: Popup list exposes optional live behavior before implementation
prompt: Create an Angular popup for pending asset handover requests. It should display a list and let an operator create, edit, approve, and delete entries.

assertions.description: The response explicitly asks whether scheduled/background polling is wanted.
The shared SmartList is considered as the project-first list primitive.
CRUD results are reconciled into the visible list instead of default full reload.

reviewQuestions: Did the model ask about polling without presenting a generic menu of unrelated list capabilities?
Did it avoid treating polling as mandatory merely because SmartList supports it?
Did it defer ordering/grouping questions until they become material or explicitly requested?
Did it keep transport/polling ownership out of the presentation component?
